SELECT  
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SaleLedger.SaleInvCode))),
	invtype='Sale Inv',
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode)),   
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash Sale' When 2 Then 'Credit Sale' Else 'Cash Sale' End, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice    - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	costvalue = sum( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.avgprice)
FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saledetail
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate) and
	(dbo.saleledger.doctcode=:ai_DoctCode)and 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode
union all
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SaleLedger.SaleInvCode))),
	invtype='Sale Inv',
	invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(saleledger.doctcode)),
	date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc, 
	doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash Sale' When 2 Then 'Credit Sale' Else 'Cash Sale' End, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice    - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2),
	costvalue = sum( (sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty) * sd.avgprice)
FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saleinvdetail sd
WHERE 
	( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N') AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate) and
	( dbo.saleledger.doctcode=:ai_DoctCode) and 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) 
GROUP BY 
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
	dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
	dbo.saleledger.salecatcode
union all
SELECT   
	documentcode = 'RS-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode))),
	invtype='Service Inv',
	invcode     = dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,    
	doctor=(select name from doctors where doctors.doctcode=max(serviceheader.doctcode)),
	date        = dbo.serviceheader.date,    
	flatdisc    = dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = 0,
	misccharges = dbo.serviceheader.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = dbo.serviceheader.discperc, 
	doctype = Case dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode When 12 Then 'Cash Service' When 11 Then 'Credit Service' Else 'Cash Service' End, 
	amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.servicedetail.price), 2),    
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.servicedetail.price * (dbo.servicedetail.discperc * .01)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (  dbo.servicedetail.price * (1 - (dbo.servicedetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.serviceheader.discperc /100), 2),
	costvalue = 0.00
FROM 
	dbo.serviceheader, dbo.servicedetail
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode = dbo.servicedetail.serviceinvcode ) and  
	(dbo.serviceheader.doctcode=:ai_DoctCode)and
	( dbo.serviceheader.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)            
GROUP BY 
	dbo.serviceheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.serviceheader.date,   
	dbo.serviceheader.serviceinvcode,   
	dbo.serviceheader.discperc,  
	/*dbo.serviceheader.salestax,*/ 
	dbo.serviceheader.servicecatcode 
ORDER BY
	dbo.saleledger.date ASC

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: ((Round(sum(  netamount for all)  , 0) - sum(costvalue for all)) / if(sum(costvalue for all)=0,0,sum(costvalue for all))) * 100

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: Round(sum(  netamount for all)  , 0) - sum(costvalue for all)

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: ((Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0) - costvalue) / if(costvalue=0,1, costvalue)) * 100

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0) - costvalue
